description: This file defines an interface for securely storing authentication tokens with an implementation that uses Android's EncryptedSharedPreferences backed by the Android Keystore for encryption. It provides methods to save, load, clear, and check the presence of session tokens, along with a factory method for creating instances with application context.

classes.name: EncryptedPrefsTokenStore
classes.description: A class implementing TokenStore that uses EncryptedSharedPreferences to securely store session tokens, leveraging Android's Keystore for encryption.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves session tokens securely in encrypted preferences.

methods.name: loadOrNull
methods.description: Loads session tokens from secure storage; returns null if none are stored or an error occurs.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all stored tokens from shared preferences.

methods.name: hasTokens
methods.description: Checks whether both access and refresh tokens are present.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate EncryptedPrefsTokenStore with application context.
